modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize every AGT sample and platform health event to the controlled max-power workload, then compute identity-bound sustained cap/TDP compliance rather than peak values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes device mapping, sample completeness and consistency math explicit and preserves system evidence, without changing the source telemetry or load intent.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Peak power can meet 90% TDP briefly while most of the run or one GPU remains below target, and it cannot detect 50 ms gaps or clock/XGMI behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A full-system max-power run may exceed cooling, PSU or rack margins; AGT overhead/storage and clock-restore behavior must be validated before stress.

review_improvement: Restores the mandatory all-GPU high-rate telemetry and exposes the workload terminology conflict, replacing a transient peak shortcut with sustained per-device proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: The criterion explicitly says consistently and minimum >=90% TDP, so a single peak is logically insufficient; the full workload-window distribution and missing-sample audit are required for every GPU. AGT indices are sparse and platform-specific, so stable device mapping must precede collection. The rocHPL/rocBLAS inconsistency changes workload behavior and coverage and cannot be guessed. At full system power, PSU/fan/cooling health is part of safe validity, not merely operational context.
